captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a stylized, blocky parametric robot head. It features a wide rectangular block as the main head structure, with two triangular cutouts representing eyes and a series of vertical rectangular slots along the bottom edge forming a grille-like mouth. On each side of the head, a cylindrical ear protrusion is mounted, supporting a thin vertical antenna rod capped with a spherical ball.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric robot head in OpenSCAD with a rectangular block for the main head. It should include customizable parameters for the antenna height, antenna ball radius, eye diameter, eye spacing offset, and mouth height, allowing the user to easily adjust the facial expressions and proportions.
captions.factory: The script constructs the head using a difference() operation on a main cube. Inside the difference, it subtracts six smaller cubes to form the mouth slots, and two rotated cylinders to cut out the eyes, positioned dynamically using the EyeSpacingOffset and EyeDiameter parameters. The left and right ears are built outside the difference block, each consisting of a horizontal cylinder base, a vertical cylinder rod scaled by AntennaHeight, and a sphere at the top representing the antenna ball with a radius of AntennaBallRadius.
